content:
# New Client Onboarding Workflow
# Format: structured SOP-style YAML (engine-agnostic).
# Assumptions (best-judgment defaults, adjust as needed):
#   - Trigger: contract signed
#   - Target duration: 10 business days end-to-end

workflow:
  name: new_client_onboarding
  version: 1.0.0
  description: End-to-end onboarding process for newly signed clients.

  trigger:
    event: contract_signed
    source: CRM
    preconditions:
      - Signed contract archived in CRM
      - Client record created with billing contact

  completion_criteria:
    - All steps completed
    - Client confirms access and scheduled kickoff
    - Account handed off to Account Management

  steps:
    - id: kickoff
      name: Internal kickoff
      owner: Sales
      sla_days: 1
      description: Sales briefs account team on contract scope, goals, and risks.
      outputs:
        - Kickoff notes in CRM

    - id: crm_setup
      name: CRM account setup
      owner: Sales
      sla_days: 2
      description: Finalize client record, contacts, and opportunity closure.
      outputs:
        - Complete CRM record
      systems:
        - CRM

    - id: billing_setup
      name: Billing and invoicing setup
      owner: Finance
      sla_days: 3
      description: Create billing profile, payment terms, and first invoice schedule.
      outputs:
        - Billing profile active
      systems:
        - Billing

    - id: provisioning
      name: Access and technical provisioning
      owner: IT
      sla_days: 5
      description: Create client accounts, grant tool access, deliver credentials securely.
      outputs:
        - Active client accounts
        - Credential handoff completed
      systems:
        - Access management
        - Email

    - id: welcome
      name: Client welcome and kickoff meeting
      owner: Account Management
      sla_days: 7
      description: Send welcome package, schedule and run kickoff meeting with client.
      outputs:
        - Kickoff meeting held
        - Shared timeline and contacts
      systems:
        - Email
        - Calendar

    - id: handoff
      name: Handoff to Account Management
      owner: Sales
      sla_days: 10
      description: Transfer ownership, confirm no open blockers, mark onboarding complete.
      outputs:
        - Signed-off onboarding record
      systems:
        - CRM

  escalations:
    - if: step exceeds sla_days
      action: Notify workflow owner and sales lead
    - if: client unresponsive for 5 business days
      action: Pause workflow and follow up via phone
